platforms.name: Claude Code and Claude Skills
platforms.install_surface: User-level agents under ~/.claude/agents and workflow skills under ~/.claude/skills.
platforms.export_surface: Markdown subagents, SKILL.md workflow packages, and command snippets.
platforms.frontmatter_rules: Markdown files use YAML frontmatter with name and description fields that should be concise enough for routing.
platforms.instruction_limits: Keep workflow skills compact and role-specific; place examples after the required workflow steps.
platforms.managed_block_strategy: Generated workflow skills are owned files in healthcare-* directories.
platforms.uninstall_strategy: Remove only generated healthcare-* workflow skill directories and installed specialist files.
platforms.test_strategy: Dry-run install, idempotent install, uninstall, and frontmatter linting.

platforms.name: Codex
platforms.install_surface: AGENTS.md instruction blocks, ~/.codex/agents specialist prompts, and ~/.codex/skills workflow skills.
platforms.export_surface: AGENTS.md managed block, specialist prompts, and SKILL.md workflow packages.
platforms.frontmatter_rules: Skills use YAML frontmatter. AGENTS.md follows directory precedence rules and must preserve user content.
platforms.instruction_limits: Keep global instructions limited to operating boundaries and routing policy.
platforms.managed_block_strategy: Use <!-- healthcare-agents:start --> managed blocks for AGENTS.md and owned healthcare-* skill directories.
platforms.uninstall_strategy: Remove managed blocks and owned generated directories only.
platforms.test_strategy: Dry-run, diff, idempotency, uninstall, and AGENTS.md preservation checks.

platforms.name: GitHub Copilot
platforms.install_surface: Repository instructions, path-specific instructions, custom agents, prompt files, and issue templates.
platforms.frontmatter_rules: Path instructions use applyTo frontmatter. Agent and prompt files use GitHub-supported Markdown conventions.
platforms.instruction_limits: Keep custom agents curated and governable; do not generate the full specialist catalog by default.
platforms.managed_block_strategy: Use managed blocks for repository instructions and owned generated files for other Copilot surfaces.
platforms.uninstall_strategy: Remove managed blocks and healthcare-generated files only.
platforms.test_strategy: Snapshot renderers, dry-run install, idempotency, and docs review.

platforms.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot Declarative Agents
platforms.install_surface: Governed enterprise export package for tenant review.
platforms.export_surface: Declarative agent instructions, starter prompts, knowledge guidance, action placeholders, tests, and admin checklist.
platforms.frontmatter_rules: No hidden system instructions in knowledge documents; instructions stay in supported agent definition fields.
platforms.instruction_limits: Keep core instructions concise and move examples, tests, and review checklists into supported companion fields.
platforms.managed_block_strategy: Export packages are generated artifacts for review, not direct tenant writes.
platforms.uninstall_strategy: Delete generated export folders; tenant deployment removal is handled by enterprise admins.
platforms.test_strategy: Validate safety boundaries, test prompts, expected outputs, and admin review checklist.

platforms.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
platforms.export_surface: Agent instructions, topics, triggers, inputs, knowledge mapping, action placeholders, escalation paths, and test scripts.
platforms.frontmatter_rules: Use explicit agent instructions and topic descriptions; do not rely on knowledge files as hidden instructions.
platforms.instruction_limits: Split instructions, topics, triggers, and tests into their supported product fields.
platforms.managed_block_strategy: Export guides are generated artifacts for admins/builders.
platforms.uninstall_strategy: Delete generated export folders; tenant agent lifecycle is managed in Copilot Studio.
platforms.test_strategy: Validate trigger phrases, test scripts, safety boundaries, and human review path.

platforms.name: Azure AI Foundry Agent Service
platforms.export_surface: Prompt agent spec, workflow agent spec, tool placeholders, identity/RBAC notes, observability, versioning, private networking, and Teams/M365 distribution notes.
platforms.frontmatter_rules: Specs must separate prompt instructions, tool schemas, identity, observability, and distribution concerns.
platforms.instruction_limits: Use versioned prompt sections and explicit tool/action contracts.
platforms.managed_block_strategy: Export specs are generated artifacts for enterprise architecture review.
platforms.uninstall_strategy: Delete generated export folders; Azure resources are managed separately.
platforms.test_strategy: Validate governance, identity, RBAC, private networking, and observability checklist coverage.
